column1: # changed-map.tsv - which checks cover which paths, for `just check-changed` (tests/check-changed.sh).
# WHY THIS EXISTS: the full gate (`just check`) runs every root gate and all ~60 suites, which
# takes many minutes on Windows. During development you only need the checks that can see
# what you changed. This file is that mapping, in one place. It is for DEVELOPMENT ONLY:
# suites assert on sibling files in ways no map can fully capture, so `just check` and the
# fleet-ops landing gate always run everything (AGENTS.md Landmines).
# FORMAT: one rule per line, <path pattern><TAB><targets>. Every rule whose pattern matches a
# changed path adds its targets. A path that matches NO rule triggers the full sweep, so an
# unmapped area is never silently skipped. Patterns are bash `[[ == ]]` globs (`*` crosses /).
#   FULL           run the full sweep instead (shared or unknown territory)
#   -              known path, nothing beyond the always-run gates
# Two rules are applied by check-changed.sh itself, not listed here:
#   - CROSS-READERS: for every changed skills/<name>/..., any suite, e2e or root gate whose
#     text names `skills/<name>/` or `../<name>/` also runs (suites that read a sibling skill).
# @always: cheap whole-repo static gates, run on every check-changed (a few seconds each).
# @serial: suites too heavy to share the machine; run alone after the parallel batch
#          (two concurrent fleet-ops runs flake - AGENTS.md Landmines, land-gate-contention).
